note: Text other programs put into the panel through POST /api/v1/activity/note (the orcaslicer-mcp connector). Keep in step with orcaslicer-mcp: server.py _compare_note and _restore_failed_note, client.py REFUSED_KEYS_DETAIL*, the range refusal. The OrcaSlicer MCP plugin's own words (its capabilities, undo results, setup view and closed banner) are here too: keep in step with orcaslicer-mcp plugin/orcaslicer_mcp_plugin.py.
